description: What a buyer sends runx's claim route for a held value (`runx.payment.purchase_claim.v1`).

claim_url.description: The endpoint this claim is sent to: a claim is good for one endpoint.

issued_at.description: When the buyer signed; runx refuses a stale claim.

receipt_digest.description: The digest of runx's receipt for the fulfilled purchase, as the purchase gave it: a purchase has none until it is fulfilled.

signature.description: The buyer's signature over the claim schema, the endpoint, the time and the receipt digest, as stable JSON.

title: PurchaseClaim
